subject: Auditing and Ethics
question_text:
10.
Financial events or conditions that may cast significant doubt on the entity's
ability to continue as a going concern does not include
(A)
Inability to comply with the terms of loan agreements.
(B)
Inability to pay creditors on due dates.
(C)
Shortage of important supplies.
(D)  Substantial operating losses.
